meta.name: NBA2 strategy catalog
meta.notes: Single source of truth for strategies. status: research (idea, no picks), candidate (paper trade; demo-mode output only), active (may generate picks).  Gates reference docs/validation-gates.html G1-G10. No strategy produces real picks until every gate passes on out-of-sample data.

strategies.name: Power-rating spread gap (single bet)
strategies.signal: Our nightly power-rating line vs. our originated fair line differ by >= 2.0 pts; originate first, then compare to market only for sizing/CLV tracking.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Model vs. market mispricing; per Dare/Dennis/Paul (2015) opening lines carry biases in specific spots, and biases vanish by close — the edge must be captured before the market moves.

strategies.name: Schedule-spot spread/total (single bet)
strategies.signal: Back-to-back (road B2B strongest), 3-in-4, altitude/travel legs, and first-game-off-rest spots; adjust minutes projections per docs/injuries-rotations.html before originating.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Fatigue/rest effects on pace and defense; NBA schedule structure makes these spots systematic.

strategies.name: Injury-report reprice (single bet)
strategies.signal: Act in the window after the official injury report drop (5 p.m. local day before; game-day updates 11 a.m.-1 p.m. local) when our injury-adjusted line differs from our pre-report originated line by >= 1.5 pts.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Opening lines have documented errors when players are absent; the market corrects by close. Value lives between report release and market convergence.

strategies.name: Big home underdog value (single bet)
strategies.signal: Historically documented anomaly (Paul & Weinbach; Compton & Sigler 2013 found home underdogs of 10+ profitable 2000-01 to 2007-08).
strategies.edge_mechanism: Uninformed bettors over-bet favorites; books shade toward the favorite.

strategies.name: High-total over fade (single bet — total)
strategies.signal: Literature reports overs over-bet at the highest totals (fair bet rejected for some totals ranges in Compton & Sigler).
strategies.edge_mechanism: Behavioral bias toward overs in high-scoring expected environments.

strategies.name: Minutes-driven player props
strategies.signal: Projected rotation minutes (from depth chart + injury redistribution, docs/injuries-rotations.html) x per-minute production rates vs. posted prop lines.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Prop lines are sensitive to minutes; systematic minutes mispricing around injuries, B2Bs, and blowouts.

strategies.name: Star-absence usage redistribution props
strategies.signal: When a high-usage player is Out, redistribute usage to next-man-up; project teammate props above baseline.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Usage is roughly conserved within a lineup; books under-adjust secondary players' props at open.

strategies.name: Repriced same-game combo (2 legs)
strategies.bet_type: player-prop combo / SGP — 2 legs, same game
strategies.signal: Only combos we reprice ourselves: joint fair probability = P1*P2 + Cov(leg1, leg2), with Cov estimated from historical co-occurrence. Bet only when our joint probability exceeds the offered implied joint probability by >= 2 percentage points.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Books adjust SGP pricing for correlation (documented in house rules); our repricing must beat their adjustment, not ignore it.

strategies.name: Gated multi-game parlay
strategies.signal: Every leg must individually pass all gates as a single bet; parlay EV must exceed straight-bet EV of the best leg after applying the correlation haircut from the matrix (different-game legs are near-independent, but shared-game-date/spread-market overlap is haircut).
strategies.edge_mechanism: Parlay compounding of small edges; math documented on docs/correlation.html.

strategies.name: Rest-spot under (single bet — total)
strategies.signal: Under in PPP-constrained rest spots and pre-break games, when our rotation projections show reduced starter minutes but no single star absence (books price star absence, not diffuse rotation reduction).
strategies.edge_mechanism: Diffuse load-management minutes reduction lowers pace and efficiency; market focuses on named stars.

strategies.name: Clutch-time environment props
strategies.signal: Late-game free-throw-heavy environments raise player-stat variance; use L2M officiating data to model end-game foul rates for overtime/last-3-min scenarios.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Intentional fouling in final 2 minutes changes scoring distribution shape; L2M reports are official data.

strategies.name: Cup-night motivation spots
strategies.signal: Emirates NBA Cup group/knockout games carry separate incentives (prize pool, advancement) that change rotation usage vs. ordinary regular-season games.
strategies.edge_mechanism: Motivation asymmetries between teams still alive vs. eliminated in Cup play.

global_rules.no_market_anchor: Originate every line from the model BEFORE viewing any market number. Market lines are recorded only after origination, for CLV measurement.
global_rules.no_pick_without_gates: The generator may not emit a pick for any strategy whose gates have not all passed on out-of-sample data. Until backtests exist, every strategy is research/candidate and produces zero real picks.
global_rules.demo_mode: Demo mode uses synthetic data with player placeholders; output is marked demo:true and is never displayed as live picks.
global_rules.staking: Quarter-Kelly, capped at 2% of bankroll per single bet and 1% per parlay/SGP leg-combination.
global_rules.portfolio_caps: Max 8 singles + 2 parlays + 2 SGPs per slate; total exposure cap 12% of bankroll; pairwise |correlation| of portfolio positions <= 0.35.
